DECLARE @batch_id BIGINT;

IF '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_mode}' = 'INITIAL'
BEGIN
    DECLARE @new_batch TABLE (batch_id BIGINT);

    INSERT INTO metadata.pipeline_run_log
    (
        adf_run_id,
        pipeline_name,
        trigger_type,
        trigger_name,
        run_status,
        start_time,
        created_date
    )
    OUTPUT INSERTED.batch_id INTO @new_batch(batch_id)
    VALUES
    (
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
        '@{pipeline().TriggerType}',
        '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',
        'RUNNING',
        SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        SYSUTCDATETIME()
    );

    SELECT @batch_id = batch_id
    FROM @new_batch;
END
ELSE IF '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_mode}' = 'RERUN'
BEGIN
    SET @batch_id =
        CAST('@{pipeline().parameters.p_previous_batch_id}' AS BIGINT);

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM metadata.pipeline_run_log
        WHERE batch_id = @batch_id
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001, 'Batch ID does not exist.', 1;
    END;

    UPDATE metadata.pipeline_run_log
    SET
        run_status = 'RUNNING',
        end_time = NULL,
        modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()
    WHERE batch_id = @batch_id;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    THROW 50002, 'Invalid p_run_mode.', 1;
END;

SELECT @batch_id AS batch_id;

SELECT
    sc.source_id,
    sc.source_name,
    sc.server_name,
    sc.database_name,
    sc.authentication_type,

    oc.object_id,
    oc.source_schema,
    oc.source_table,
    oc.target_table,
    oc.load_type,
    oc.primary_key_columns,
    oc.watermark_column,

    oc.landing_enabled,
    oc.bronze_enabled,
    oc.silver_enabled,
    oc.gold_enabled,
    oc.execution_order

FROM metadata.source_config sc

INNER JOIN metadata.object_config oc
    ON sc.source_id = oc.source_id

WHERE
    sc.source_id = @{pipeline().parameters.p_source_id}
    AND sc.is_active = 1
    AND oc.is_active = 1
    AND oc.landing_enabled = 1

ORDER BY
    oc.execution_order,
    oc.object_id;

DECLARE @next_attempt INT;

SELECT
    @next_attempt = ISNULL(MAX(attempt_number), 0) + 1
FROM metadata.table_run_log
WHERE batch_id =
    CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
  AND object_id = @{item().object_id}
  AND layer_name = 'LANDING';

INSERT INTO metadata.table_run_log
(
    batch_id,
    object_id,
    layer_name,
    attempt_number,
    run_status,
    start_time,
    created_date,
    modified_date
)
VALUES
(
    CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT),
    @{item().object_id},
    'LANDING',
    @next_attempt,
    'RUNNING',
    SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    SYSUTCDATETIME()
);

UPDATE metadata.table_run_log
SET
    run_status = 'SUCCESS',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    error_message = NULL,
    modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHERE batch_id =
    CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
  AND object_id = @{item().object_id}
  AND layer_name = 'LANDING'
  AND run_status = 'RUNNING';

UPDATE metadata.table_run_log
SET
    run_status = 'FAILED',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    error_message = 'Landing Copy Activity failed. Check ADF activity output.',
    modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHERE batch_id =
    CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
  AND object_id = @{item().object_id}
  AND layer_name = 'LANDING'
  AND run_status = 'RUNNING';

WITH ExpectedObjects AS
(
    SELECT
        oc.object_id
    FROM metadata.object_config oc
    INNER JOIN metadata.source_config sc
        ON sc.source_id = oc.source_id
    WHERE sc.source_id = @{pipeline().parameters.p_source_id}
      AND sc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.bronze_enabled = 1
),
LatestAttempt AS
(
    SELECT
        tr.object_id,
        tr.run_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY tr.object_id
            ORDER BY tr.attempt_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.table_run_log tr
    WHERE tr.batch_id = CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
      AND tr.layer_name = 'LANDING'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM ExpectedObjects e
            LEFT JOIN LatestAttempt la
                ON la.object_id = e.object_id
               AND la.rn = 1
            WHERE la.object_id IS NULL
               OR la.run_status <> 'SUCCESS'
        )
        THEN 'FAILED'
        ELSE 'SUCCESS'
    END AS landing_status;

WITH ExpectedObjects AS
(
    SELECT
        oc.object_id
    FROM metadata.object_config oc
    INNER JOIN metadata.source_config sc
        ON sc.source_id = oc.source_id
    WHERE sc.source_id = @{pipeline().parameters.p_source_id}
      AND sc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.silver_enabled = 1
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM metadata.table_run_log br
          WHERE br.batch_id =
                CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
            AND br.object_id = oc.object_id
            AND br.layer_name = 'BRONZE'
            AND br.run_status = 'SUCCESS'
            AND br.attempt_number =
            (
                SELECT MAX(br2.attempt_number)
                FROM metadata.table_run_log br2
                WHERE br2.batch_id = br.batch_id
                  AND br2.object_id = br.object_id
                  AND br2.layer_name = 'BRONZE'
            )
      )
),
LatestSilverAttempt AS
(
    SELECT
        tr.object_id,
        tr.run_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY tr.object_id
            ORDER BY tr.attempt_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.table_run_log tr
    WHERE tr.batch_id =
        CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
      AND tr.layer_name = 'SILVER'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '@{variables('v_bronze_status')}' <> 'SUCCESS'
            THEN 'FAILED'
        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM ExpectedObjects e
            LEFT JOIN LatestSilverAttempt sa
                ON sa.object_id = e.object_id
               AND sa.rn = 1
            WHERE sa.object_id IS NULL
               OR sa.run_status <> 'SUCCESS'
        )
            THEN 'FAILED'
        ELSE 'SUCCESS'
    END AS silver_status;

WITH ExpectedObjects AS
(
    SELECT
        oc.object_id
    FROM metadata.object_config oc
    INNER JOIN metadata.source_config sc
        ON sc.source_id = oc.source_id
    WHERE sc.source_id = @{pipeline().parameters.p_source_id}
      AND sc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.is_active = 1
      AND oc.gold_enabled = 1
      AND EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM metadata.table_run_log sr
          WHERE sr.batch_id =
                CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
            AND sr.object_id = oc.object_id
            AND sr.layer_name = 'SILVER'
            AND sr.run_status = 'SUCCESS'
            AND sr.attempt_number =
            (
                SELECT MAX(sr2.attempt_number)
                FROM metadata.table_run_log sr2
                WHERE sr2.batch_id = sr.batch_id
                  AND sr2.object_id = sr.object_id
                  AND sr2.layer_name = 'SILVER'
            )
      )
),
LatestGoldAttempt AS
(
    SELECT
        tr.object_id,
        tr.run_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY tr.object_id
            ORDER BY tr.attempt_number DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.table_run_log tr
    WHERE tr.batch_id =
        CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT)
      AND tr.layer_name = 'GOLD'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '@{variables('v_silver_status')}' <> 'SUCCESS'
            THEN 'FAILED'
        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM ExpectedObjects e
            LEFT JOIN LatestGoldAttempt ga
                ON ga.object_id = e.object_id
               AND ga.rn = 1
            WHERE ga.object_id IS NULL
               OR ga.run_status <> 'SUCCESS'
        )
            THEN 'FAILED'
        ELSE 'SUCCESS'
    END AS gold_status;

UPDATE metadata.pipeline_run_log
SET
    bronze_status = '@{variables('v_bronze_status')}',
    silver_status = '@{variables('v_silver_status')}',
    gold_status = '@{variables('v_gold_status')}',

    run_status =
        CASE
            WHEN '@{variables('v_bronze_status')}' = 'FAILED'
              OR '@{variables('v_silver_status')}' = 'FAILED'
              OR '@{variables('v_gold_status')}' = 'FAILED'
            THEN 'FAILED'

            WHEN '@{variables('v_bronze_status')}' = 'RUNNING'
              OR '@{variables('v_silver_status')}' = 'RUNNING'
              OR '@{variables('v_gold_status')}' = 'RUNNING'
            THEN 'RUNNING'

            ELSE 'SUCCESS'
        END,

    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    modified_date = SYSUTCDATETIME()

WHERE batch_id =
    CAST('@{variables('v_batch_id')}' AS BIGINT);
